data: Which of the following options accurately describes the predicted polarity scores in the provided figure?

The figure shows the distribution of predicted polarity scores across three classes for Yelp'13 sentences. The x-axis represents the polarity, ranging from -1 to 1. The y-axis represents the predicted probability of each class. There are two graphs, one for HierNet and one for MILNet. Each graph contains three lines representing negative, neutral, and positive classes, respectively. The lines are colored red, gray, and blue. The red line represents the negative class, the gray line represents the neutral class, and the blue line represents the positive class. The negative class has a higher probability at lower values of polarity, while the positive class has a higher probability at higher values of polarity. The neutral class has a relatively flat distribution.
